summary: Constructor-style initializer for the dynamic track-object manager (the global instance dword_5EA560, called from DynMan_Init). Allocates and fills a fixed 104-entry vehicle data array (36-byte entries seeded from the static table at unk_5EC6E4), then walks the scene node list (count from AudioNetworkNodeCount) and categorizes each linked-list node by its name string (dspoly, dsindicator, dscone, cone, post, sign, wheel, wing, part) into per-category count buckets kept in a local scratch array. For each category it allocates a small 36-byte-entry array and a large vtable-led array (792/808-byte entries with off_59E720 as the initial vtable), fills the small arrays from the scratch buckets and the large arrays from the buckets plus reserved capacity (wheel +416, wing +208, part +832) with static per-object data, appends five global node pointers (dword_8AD074..8AD084) to the dspoly bucket, and finally allocates a combined pointer array of total-count entries returned to the caller.
